an10.72:4.2: ‘These several well-known Licchavis have plunged deep into the Great Wood to see the Buddha. Driving a succession of fine carriages, they’re making a colossal racket. But the Buddha has said that sound is a thorn to absorption. Let’s go to the Gosiṅga Sal Wood. There we can meditate comfortably, free of noise and crowds.’
an10.72:4.3: Then, sir, those venerables went to the Gosiṅga Sal Wood.
an10.72:4.4: There those venerables meditated comfortably, free of noise and crowds.”
